question: Why does this curriculum separate 'Build It' (phases/**/code/main.py) from 'Use It' (src/, cli/, ui/)?
options: Because Python cannot connect to Google Cloud directly
So you can learn and verify every mathematical formula and algorithm from scratch in <2 seconds offline before running it at production scale on EmbeddingGemma-2 and GCP
Because BM25 only works in the command line
explanation: Building from scratch first removes black-box magic and cloud dependencies while learning core concepts; 'Use It' then applies the exact same math on real google/embeddinggemma-2 weights, Sarvam AI docs, and GCP Vertex AI/BigQuery.

question: Why should you always install Python packages inside a virtual environment (.venv) rather than using sudo pip install?
options: Virtual environments make matrix multiplication 10x faster
sudo pip install can overwrite OS-level Python packages and cause dependency conflicts across projects
Hugging Face blocks downloads outside virtual environments
explanation: Isolating dependencies inside .venv prevents version collisions and protects system utilities that rely on the OS Python installation.

question: In the route-aware preflight architecture, when does run_preflight(route_name) return a non-zero exit code?
options: Whenever an optional GPU is not detected
Only when one or more probes in route.required return Result(ok=False, ...)
Whenever gcloud is not installed on the beginner route
Every time the script is run without arguments
explanation: Required probes gate the exit code for a given route, whereas optional probes report READY or INFO so learners on CPU-only or offline machines are never blocked.

question: Which command launches the 4-Tab Interactive FastAPI Web Studio once your production virtual environment is active?
explanation: The 'serve' subcommand in cli/rag_cli.py starts the Uvicorn server hosting ui/app.py on port 8090.
